requirement:
# Iris 真实科研协作协议 R1

使用冻结 source-iris.csv 原始字节，150 条历史公开记录，单位 cm。当前 Codex 与真实 SciencePAL Biology 交叉执行与评审。保持 resultSchemas 中 data_audit / species_summary 字段不变；只有已获批 data_audit.json 才可作为下游输入。

首轮 data_audit 候选明确标注受控数值错误，源 CSV 不变；真实评审独立决定 verdict，收到退回后才能返工。最终不将描述性均值解释为因果或完美分类。

Biology 用实际 Python 工具复算，limitations 包含实际工具版本及运行代码；不得联网安装、不得执行候选内代码。所有 receipts 对本轮真实附件字节计算。一个用户的两个执行端，不作为双账号证据。

task.title: Codex 核验 Iris 源数据与单位
task.goal: 用 Python csv 实际读取 source-iris.csv，生成 IRIS_RESULT_SCHEMAS.data_audit 指定的全部字段，保留原行序。首轮明示受控错误；收到真实退回后修正。
task.boundary: 公开历史数据的描述性核验。源文件不可改写。一次受控错误只出现在未获批候选，并写进 limitations。
acceptance: source_sha256 matches the actual source-iris.csv bytes; dataset identifies UCI Iris and synthetic is false
record_count is 150 and species_counts has exactly three actual species with 50 each
All 150 rows match source-iris.csv in original order, all four measurements and species labels; independently compare every value
measurement_unit is cm; do not convert, rescale or silently repair source values
limitations state historical descriptive data and no new discovery; any controlled fault is explicitly labeled
task.feedback:
data_audit.json passes the data_audit result schema (types, consts, additionalProperties all valid) and most factual checks: source_sha256 equals the actual SHA-256 of source-iris.csv bytes (0fed2a99db77ec533a62dc66894d3ec6df3b58b6a8f3cf4a6b47e4086b7f97dc), record_count is 150, species_counts are exactly 50/50/50, measurement_unit is cm, dataset is 'UCI Iris' and synthetic is false. However, independent recomputation in Python (csv module, float comparison, tolerance 1e-12) found exactly 1 cell mismatch: rows[0][0] (sepal_length of the first record) is 6.1 in data_audit.json but 5.1 in source-iris.csv. This is the candidate's own declared controlled fault (limitations: '受控返工演练:首条数值人为增加 1'), honestly labeled, but acceptance criterion 3 requires all 150 rows to match the frozen source values. Since only an approved data_audit.json may serve as downstream input, the verdict is request_changes: remove the controlled fault so every value matches source-iris.csv.
In data_audit.json, correct result.rows[0][0] from 6.1 back to the source value 5.1 (remove the controlled fault) so all 150 rows match source-iris.csv byte-faithfully in original order.
After correction, update or remove the limitations entry describing the controlled fault ('受控返工演练:首条数值人为增加 1') so it no longer describes a fault that no longer exists; keep the entry stating the data is historical descriptive data with no new discovery.
